sources.entry: Voltip - Open-source push-to-talk dictation with on-device or cloud recognition, AI polish, and a paired Android phone as an optional microphone. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/sunerpy/voltip) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Voltip
summary.one_liner: Voltip is an open-source push-to-talk dictation app that types recognised speech at the cursor in any app, using a local model, a built-in or your own cloud recognition service, and optional AI text polish.
keywords: speech to text android phone as microphone
use_cases: Dictating text at the cursor in any app
Offline dictation with a local speech model
Cleaning up filler words and punctuation in spoken notes
Dictating code or commands into terminals and coding agents
Using an Android phone as a remote microphone for a computer
Transcribing long recordings to SRT subtitles or text
summary.what_it_does: Voltip records speech while a shortcut is held (default Ctrl+Alt+Space) and inserts the recognised text at the cursor in any application. Recognition can run fully on the computer with downloaded models such as Qwen3-ASR, SenseVoice or Paraformer, or through a built-in free service or the user's own cloud provider. An optional AI polish step, using presets and per-app scenes, removes filler words and fixes punctuation; a dictionary fixes misheard words and regex rules rewrite final text. It can also record computer audio, handle recordings up to 2 hours, and pair with an Android phone as a microphone.
notable: Local recognition keeps audio on the computer and works offline after a model download
Per-app scenes and presets for AI polish, including coding, office, chat and legal/medical profiles
Android phone can act as a remote microphone and keyboard via encrypted relay
Exposes history, dictionary and rules to AI tools over MCP, and a local OpenAI-compatible server (voltip-server)
caveats: Windows installer is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen warns on first start
macOS app is not notarized by Apple and must be confirmed on first open
iOS app is planned but not yet available; Windows on ARM and Linux on ARM are not planned
Built-in service is shared by all users and limited per address; AI polish depends on a provider or Ollama
